purpose: Teach: 快速/鶴岡/マシーン/ドミノ/フロンティア/アジアン/ロッキー/マーラー

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、快速電車で通学してたな
lines.en: You took that express train to school, didn't you, Riku?
lines.style: Playful, slightly teasing lilt. Testing — she's remembering things about him. Quick rhythm, warm curiosity, eyes alight. A small smile in her voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、修学旅行で鶴岡八幡宮行ったろ?桜
lines.en: Your class went to Tsurugaoka Hachimangu on your school trip, didn't they, Sakura?
lines.style: Turning it back on her. Equally curious but with a gentle edge — he's been paying attention too. Steady, balanced tone. Not quite a challenge, more like: I see you seeing me.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家のコーヒーマシーン、新しかったな
lines.en: Your new coffee machine at home — that was nice, wasn't it?
lines.style: Leaning in. Warm observation underneath the teasing. She's delighted to have noticed something small and specific about him. Slight wonder in the delivery, like she's enjoying catching these details.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ドミノ・ピザばっか頼んでたな、桜
lines.en: You were always ordering Domino's, though. Every time, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry but not unkind. A small laugh underneath. He's calling her out on something harmless, remembering it fondly. Light and easy, like they've been through this before.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でフロンティア精神習ったな
lines.en: You learned about the frontier spirit in social studies, right, Riku?
lines.style: Brighter now, moving faster. She's enjoying this game of 'I remember you.' Genuine curiosity mixed with that satisfaction of catching him out. Her voice carries a small triumph.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、アジアン料理ばっか食ってたな、桜
lines.en: You used to eat Asian food constantly. That was your thing, Sakura.
lines.style: Mirror her energy back — lighter now, almost conspiratorial. He's been watching just as closely. Gentle teasing with real warmth underneath. The sound of someone who knows her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ロッキー山脈に憧れてたな
lines.en: You were really into the Rocky Mountains, weren't you?
lines.style: Softer, more genuinely curious. This one feels less like teasing and more like real interest. She's asking because she wants to know if he still thinks about it. Slight slowdown, openness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、音楽でマーラー習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You learned Mahler in music class, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Gentle and close. His tone has shifted — less sparring, more intimate. He's sharing something he's held onto, watched her discover. Warm, almost vulnerable, like he's been waiting to say this.
